dialogues.speaker: Hitomi
dialogues.text: To think that there were so many other preparation techniques for tea leaves apart from steaming! Tea ceremony, observed at its origin — profundity, such profundity...

dialogues.speaker: Hitomi
dialogues.text: Are you interested in tea preparation too? Then allow me to briefly expound on my understanding...

dialogues.speaker: Hitomi
dialogues.text: They say that Inazuman tea and tea ceremonies originate from Liyue, and so Liyue is considered the origin of such practices.

dialogues.speaker: Hitomi
dialogues.text: Today, however, Inazuman and Liyue tea ceremonies have completely diverged.

dialogues.speaker: Hitomi
dialogues.text: In Qiaoying Village, this novel roasted tea exudes a vibrant aroma.

dialogues.speaker: Hitomi
dialogues.text: I think it can be considered the harmony of tea ceremonies.

dialogues.speaker: Hitomi
dialogues.text: The blend of the same tea leaves with the tastes of new places eventually causes it to evolve into new forms.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tea possesses an essence that cannot be changed.

dialogues.speaker: Hitomi
dialogues.text: Well, you're right. No matter how the ceremonies change, the feelings of the people who drink tea are always the same.

dialogues.speaker: Hitomi
dialogues.text: These are what you mean by "the things that never change," yes?

dialogues.speaker: Hitomi
dialogues.text: Ah, who knew tea encompassed such vast knowledge! I've learned so much!

dialogues.speaker: Hitomi
dialogues.text: See you! Let's have another discussion next time.

dialogues.speaker: Hitomi
dialogues.text: You're too kind. I'm merely expressing my feelings as one who adores tea ceremonies.
